column1: # established_placeholder.tsv — BUILD SUPPORT ONLY, NOT SEED DATA.
# This file exists so the `//go:embed seeds/established_*.tsv` pattern in
# core/cli/guard_established.go compiles before the generated per-ecosystem
# ...) land. go:embed fails the BUILD when a pattern matches no file, and the
# loader must tolerate the tables' absence gracefully instead.
# It carries ZERO rows and always will: every line starts with '#'. The real
# tables are generated registry-wide qualification data
# and are produced by the seed pipeline, not hand-edited here. When they land,
# this placeholder is still harmless — it parses to an empty table under an
# ecosystem key no lookup ever uses.
